name: code/refactor
title: Restructure code safely
summary: Restructure code without changing what it does: tests first, one small move at a time, tests after each.
when: Use when the user wants code restructured and the same behaviour kept.
steps: Call run_command with the project's test command, such as pytest; when tests already fail, stop and report that, otherwise read that they pass.
Call file_outline on the file to see its functions, classes and line numbers without reading it all.
Call grep_files with the name of each function being moved to list every place that calls it.
Move one small piece with apply_patch and change no behaviour and no public name in that step.
Call run_command with the same test command after each move and read that the same tests still pass.
Call undo_changes when a step changes any test result, then cut that move smaller and try again.
Answer with the moves made, the test result before and after, and anything still left to restructure.
next: The final answer must list each move with its file, confirm the tests gave the same result before and after, and name anything still to restructure.
